source.name: Ferrari – Ferrari and HP announce a title partnership
source.quote: Today, Ferrari and HP Inc. announced a historic, multi-year title partnership.

source.name: Ferrari – Ferrari and Shell renew their partnership
source.quote: This agreement, which will take effect on 1 January 2026, encompasses Scuderia Ferrari HP, Ferrari Hypercar, and the Ferrari Challenge Series.

source.name: Ferrari – Ferrari presents the brand new partnership with UniCredit
source.quote: further details of the multi-year premium partnership, that was first announced in September 2024, have been revealed

source.name: Ferrari – Scuderia Ferrari HP announces a multi-year agreement with IBM as a Premium Partner
source.quote: Scuderia Ferrari HP is pleased to announce a multi-year agreement with IBM, a leading provider of technology and consulting expertise, effective from January 1 2025.

source.name: Ferrari – Scuderia Ferrari HP extends partnership with CEVA Logistics, which becomes a Premium Partner
source.quote: Scuderia Ferrari HP is pleased to announce the multi-year extension of its collaboration with CEVA Logistics, which becomes a Premium Partner of the team while continuing in its role as Official Logistics Provider. Starting in 2026

source.name: Ferrari – Scuderia Ferrari HP extends its partnership with Philip Morris International
source.quote: PMI’s ZYN brand will appear on the Formula 1 car livery at a series of selected Grands Prix starting from this weekend’s Abu Dhabi race.

source.name: PUMA – Ferrari and PUMA announce long-term partnership extension
source.quote: PUMA, the global sport-lifestyle brand will continue to be the official licensing partner for Ferrari branded products and the official supplier of team and race wear for Scuderia Ferrari.

source.name: Ferrari – Ambipar Team Partner page
source.quote: Ambipar is a global leader in environmental solutions and invests and operates decarbonization, circular economy, energy transition and environmental regeneration projects.

source.name: Ferrari – Ferrari signs a multi-year partnership agreement with BingX
source.quote: Under the terms of the agreement – signed today and taking effect on January 1, 2026 – BingX will become a Team Partner of Scuderia Ferrari HP.

source.name: Ferrari – Scuderia Ferrari HP partners page
Ferrari – Bitdefender Team Partner page
source.quote: Bitdefender provides cybersecurity solutions with leading security efficacy, performance, and ease of use to enterprise organizations and consumers.

source.name: Ferrari – Richard Mille Team Partner page
source.quote: Founded in 2001, RICHARD MILLE quickly established itself as one of the pre-eminent players within the watchmaking industry

source.name: Ferrari – Genesys Team Partner page
source.quote: With the AI-Powered Experience Orchestration platform Genesys enables organizations to deliver the best customer and employee experiences.

source.name: Ferrari – WHOOP Team Partner page
source.quote: Founded in 2012 and headquartered in Boston, WHOOP has raised more than $400 million in venture capital

source.name: Ferrari – DXC Technology Team Partner page
source.quote: DXC Technology helps global companies run their mission-critical systems and operations while modernizing IT, optimizing data architectures, and ensuring security and scalability across public, private and hybrid clouds.

source.name: Ferrari – ZCG Team Partner page
source.quote: ZCG is a leading, privately held global firm comprised of three dynamic, cross-disciplinary platforms: private markets asset management, business consulting services, and technology development and solutions.

source.name: Ferrari – Scuderia Ferrari HP partners page
Ferrari – Scuderia Ferrari HP announces a multi-year partnership with Chivas Regal as Official Team Partner
source.quote: Scuderia Ferrari HP is pleased to announce a new multi-year partnership with Chivas Regal, the luxury Scotch whisky, who becomes an Official Team Partner

source.name: Ferrari – OMR Team Partner page
source.quote: The OMR Automotive Group, founded in 1919, is an Italian leader in automotive and industrial vehicle components.

summary: 2026 F1 car (SF-26): HP title partner on the front with Shell; UniCredit on the engine cover/sleeve; IBM, Puma, ZYN, CEVA, Ambipar, BingX, Peroni, Bitdefender, Richard Mille, Genesys, WHOOP, DXC, ZCG, Ray-Ban, Chivas Regal and OMR Automotive as partners. Pirelli is the league-wide tyre supplier.
